title: Identity, account session, and operation lifecycle dossier surfaces

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers memberships cache-first, resolves account documents, remembers/sorts the last account, activates one account, subscribes to broad account data, derives lookup indexes and applies financial filtering in memory. Switching/deactivation removes listeners and clears in-memory context but does not own durable pending-work disposition.
surfaces.notes: Target account session is a lifecycle capability, not a Firestore-listener container. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Authorized Accounts and membership/financial capability derive from validated Principal and active server membership
No hidden rows are downloaded for in-memory filtering
Remembered Account selection is convenience only and cannot grant access
syncRequirements: Bootstrap Account catalog and caller membership/capability stream
One encrypted environment/Principal/Account local database namespace
Workspace switch cancels prior observations and keeps queued work in its original Account

migration.rule: Correlate source Account/member IDs to stable target IDs and import only namespaced last-selection preference when still authorized; do not migrate listener/cache mechanics.
reconciliation: Remembered selections resolve only to active imported memberships

tests: Cross-Account local-row and pending-operation isolation tests
acceptance: Account discovery distinguishes cached/stale/unavailable from no membership and switching cannot leak or misroute rows/operations

surfaces.currentBehavior: Routes the app among invite signup, authentication, account selection, and main content; tears down account/project/inventory in-memory contexts when auth/account changes; shows network and media-upload state. It does not gate provider signout on pending durable work.
surfaces.notes: Root composition must distinguish local unlock, authorization freshness, sync readiness, and pending work. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Root state is derived from validated Principal, invite flow and authorized Account selection
Signed-out/revoked transitions cannot expose a previous Account database
syncRequirements: Renders local database, required-stream, operation and media readiness
Orders account teardown/logout through pending-work disposition before database/key cleanup

migration.rule: Migrate no provider/root-listener state; preserve only approved restoration preference inside the environment/Principal/Account namespace.
reconciliation: No target root imports provider SDK or deactivates feature contexts independently
Every root state has an explicit readiness/error transition

acceptance: The root reports honest offline and operation state and cannot lose pending work through direct provider signout

surfaces.currentBehavior: Displays account profile/actions, deactivates in-memory account state for switching, and after a simple confirmation directly deactivates context and signs out Firebase without inspecting pending operations or uploads.
surfaces.notes: Target invokes AccountSessionEnding rather than identity-provider signout directly. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Account profile/action visibility derives from current active membership and capability
Logout/account removal follows local-data protection and exact pending-work confirmation
syncRequirements: Switch/logout coordinates operation/media queues and preserves them in the original Account namespace
Routine logout cannot delete encrypted local state with unresolved work

migration.rule: Map Account profile/logo through target Account/Attachment records; migrate no direct signout or context-deactivation mechanics.

tests: Account profile, switch, clean logout, sync-first logout, destructive exact-count confirmation and cancel tests
acceptance: Users can switch or sign out without silent data loss or cross-Account upload

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines an unused placeholder/debug Settings view whose signout button directly calls AuthManager without confirmation or account/pending-work cleanup; repository search finds only its preview construction.
surfaces.notes: Do not carry this duplicate signout surface into the redesigned app.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines the Firestore-Codable Account document with document ID, display name, owner UID, optional logo attachment, and timestamps omitted from its explicit Codable keys.
surfaces.notes: Target domain/read values must not carry Firestore annotations or silently omit required version/audit fields. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: RLS exposes an Account only through active membership
Ordinary updates cannot change immutable tenant identity or ownership
syncRequirements: Bootstrap Account catalog synchronizes visibility-safe Account summaries and stable IDs
Logo bytes follow Attachment authorization/local lifecycle

migration.rule: Preserve source Account ID/name and correlate owner UID to Principal membership; map logo reference to stable AttachmentID and server timestamps.

tests: Account mapper/constraint/RLS/Sync summary and attachment-visibility tests
acceptance: Every required source Account resolves to one tenant-isolated target Account with explainable membership and logo evidence

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines Firestore-Codable account membership with UID, role, company financial scope, allowed fee categories and display fields. Missing financial access defaults to full for owner/admin and none for employee/nil; timestamps are intentionally excluded from decoding.
surfaces.notes: Server/download authorization owns enforcement; local resolved defaults are display/UX behavior only. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Membership/role/financial access are server data, never user-editable Auth metadata
RLS/Sync/MCP enforce the same full/limited/none visibility
Handlers protect cross-Account escalation and unsafe self/last-owner changes
syncRequirements: Caller membership/capability is in bootstrap stream; admin member directory is capability-gated
Revocation removes entitlement on reconnect and drives approved offline lease state

migration.rule: Correlate source UID to stable Principal/auth identity; explicitly map role, financial access and allowed category grants, quarantining ambiguous defaults.

tests: Membership RLS/Sync/MCP parity, escalation, revoked, limited/no-financial and self-lockout tests
acceptance: A member receives exactly authorized rows/capabilities across app, Sync and MCP without relying on client filtering

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines Firestore-Codable invite state including account, email, role, proposed financial access, token, creator and lifecycle timestamps, plus current custom-scheme invite URL generation.
surfaces.notes: Target preview disclosure, token lifetime, authorization and idempotency require one trusted contract. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Store only one-way digest of high-entropy single-use expiring token
Preview is rate-limited/non-enumerating and reveals minimum fields
Acceptance binds authenticated Principal once and validates proposed grants
Raw secrets and Auth subjects never enter Sync/MCP/logs
syncRequirements: Admin-only stream contains redacted pending-invite summaries without secrets/digests
Preview/accept are online trusted boundaries; accepted membership then enters authorized streams

migration.rule: Map pending source invites with Account/email/role/access/lifecycle; rotate or invalidate legacy tokens unless a separately reviewed secure transition preserves them.

acceptance: Invites support onboarding without making token possession permanent membership or leaking administrative secrets

surfaces.currentBehavior: Uses mock account/member services to verify zero/one/multiple account discovery, remembered-account sorting, discovery errors, selection persistence and deactivation behavior in AccountContext.
blockers: Extend target suite for stale authorization, account isolation and pending-work lifecycle
surfaces.notes: Preserve useful outcomes, not Firebase ListenerRegistration-shaped test seams.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Resolves request UID/account from AsyncLocalStorage, then runtime-selected account, environment variables, and finally hardcoded production user/account defaults for non-request modes.
surfaces.notes: Target must fail closed without an authenticated principal and explicit authorized account; hardcoded production fallbacks are defects, not parity. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: Every request validates issuer/audience/subject/expiry and resolves one Principal
Requested Account requires active membership/capability
No environment/runtime/hardcoded Principal or Account fallback
Errors are non-enumerating and redacted
syncRequirements: MCP is server-query/command based and does not use client PowerSync state; it uses the same authorization facts and versioned domain contracts

migration.rule: Migrate no runtime/default context; deploy explicit environment configuration and correlate legacy Firebase subjects to Principals.
reconciliation: No production ID literals/fallback paths in target MCP

acceptance: Every MCP operation is attributable to the real caller and selected authorized Account with no silent fallback

surfaces.currentBehavior: Reads/writes root Firestore mcpUserState/{uid} to persist an active account selection across stateless MCP HTTP requests.
surfaces.notes: Account selection remains a capability, but independent Firebase state does not enter the target application.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Registers list_accounts and switch_account. It lists membership-derived accounts and verifies a requested membership before updating in-memory and Firestore active-account state; errors and success text include raw account/UID details.
surfaces.notes: Target keeps explicit authorized account choice but uses shared typed queries/commands, stable errors and redacted telemetry. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; named blockers gate provider/schema implementation or policy enablement without changing this target-neutral owner and boundary.

securityRequirements: List returns only active caller memberships and visibility-safe Account summaries
Selection revalidates membership and never persists independent authorization
Responses/errors redact raw UID/token details
syncRequirements: MCP account selection is bounded request/session context, not a Firestore/user-state record and not a PowerSync client preference

migration.rule: Retire root mcpUserState and current runtime selection; correlate memberships through target Principal identity and require explicit selection when ambiguous.
reconciliation: Account list membership parity by Principal
Zero target mcpUserState or hardcoded-default dependencies

tests: MCP zero/one/many Account list, explicit select, nonmember, revoke, session isolation and no-fallback tests
acceptance: MCP can operate across authorized Accounts explicitly without turning selection state into authorization
